title: QA run · surface:cli (21/26) · 580fd4ed · 2026-10-20 · 12 PASS / 9 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 5 NOT-RUN
body:
QA run record for the 18.0 round-3 top-up, server half (2): `surface:cli`. The anchor is #24579. The maintainer approved this top-up, dispatched from session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi` on 2026-10-20. Earlier rounds ran at `5b14b7f3` (round 1, cli area record #24551) and `ba4afcc2` (round 2, Tier 1 record #24598). Sibling records from this round: `surface:build` (filed next) and the walled pass #24783.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e`. The console was NOT built, by dispatch decision. `/_console/` answers 503 "The ObjectStack Console is not built …", and the plugin list shows `ConsoleNotBuilt`.
- build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (35 s), then `pnpm build --concurrency=2`, 76/76 tasks in 10 m 24 s. `check-dev-prereqs` is green.
- Tier 1: each pin file ran in its own vitest invocation (`npx vitest run --maxWorkers=1 FILE` from the owning package). `*.e2e.test.*` files ran with `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`, everything else without it. 61 files, 05:09–05:40 UTC.
- Tier 2: two runner agents ran in parallel, driving the built CLI (`node packages/cli/bin/run.js`, `@objectstack/cli/18.0.0-next.5`, node v22.22.0) on scratch copies, 05:09–05:26 UTC.
  - One runner had boot-free items. The other had boot-needing items: at most one server of its own at a time, each on a random high port with its own file DB, and `OS_PORT` exported beside `-p`.
  - Seed admin `admin@objectos.ai`.
- Tier 3: deferred, not run.
- `checklist-select.mjs surface:cli --json` resolved 26 runnable items. Revisions are listed below.

## Scope (selector `surface:cli`, 26 items; revision each)

- Tier 1 (16): `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed` r6 · `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18` r3 · `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json` r6 · `cli.verify-verdict-exit-mapping` r2 · `cli.datasource-introspect-codegen` r6 · `cli.dev-automigrate-policy` r3 · `cli.migrate-meta-write-stored-and-all` r2 · `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` r2 · `cli.meta-package-flags-and-explain` r2 · `cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts` r1 · `cli.verify-derived-proof-families` r2 · `integration-system.connector-stdio-default-deny` r2 · `integration-system.connector-descriptor-audit` r2 · `integration-system.external-schema-drift-gate` r3 · `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` r4 · `platform-core.serve-composition-v18` r2

- P0 items (4): `ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed`, `cli.dev-boot-contract`, `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`, `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals`.

## Tier 2: driven by hand

### cli.dev-boot-contract (P0) → PARTIAL

Boot: `OS_PORT=P pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:RUN/dev/data.db`.

- a[0] → **blocked**, environment (the console is not built, by dispatch decision).
  - Health answered 200 after about 20 s.
  - `GET /api/v1/ready` → `{"success":true,"data":{"status":"ready","state":"running"}}`.
  - `/_console/` → 503 "Console is not built", so the console leg could not be consulted.
- a[1] → pass.
  - Boot 1: sign-in as admin@objectos.ai / admin123 → 200. A wrong-password control → 401 INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD.
  - Boot 2 on the same DB with `--admin-password changed99`: admin123 → 200, same user id and createdAt; changed99 → 401.
- a[2] → pass. The Database line printed per variant:
  - `-d file` → that file.
  - `-d :memory:` → `:memory:` with SqlDriver(better-sqlite3).
  - `OS_DATABASE_URL` and `DATABASE_URL` → their files.
  - Config-declared default datasource (scratch stack) → its file, and no `.objectstack/data` was created.
  - Legacy `dev.db` → that file, with the notice.
  - Nothing chosen → `file:CWD/.objectstack/data/objectstack.db`.
- a[3] → pass.
  - `🧪 Fresh OS_HOME: /tmp/objectstack-dev-…`, with the DB inside it. The directory was gone after SIGINT.
  - `showcase_external.db` side files are the documented #5594 carve-out.
- a[4] → pass. `↪ server bound to port 47732 (requested 47731)`, and both ports answered health 200.
- a[5] → pass.
  - After touching `src/ui/actions/index.ts`: `⚠ dist/objectstack.json is OLDER than your sources — this boot serves the STALE build.`, then the newest-source and fix lines.
  - The server still came up.
- a[6] → pass.
  - In an empty directory: EXIT=1, stdout `✗ Config file not found in …`, stderr `Run in a directory with objectstack.config.ts, pass --artifact PATH-OR-URL (angle brackets in the original), or run from the monorepo root.`
- negative[0]–[3] → pass.
  - A planted row survived a nothing-chosen restart.
  - `--database-driver memory` → oclif allowlist error, exit 2.
  - `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER=memory|mingo|in-memory` → exit 1 before any Database line.
  - `-d memory://` and `-d mingo://` → refused after the Database line, exit 1, naming `--fresh` and `:memory:`.
  - With a legacy `dev.db` present, no fresh `objectstack.db` was created.
  - The shifted port was always the one reported.
- steps[8] exit codes: plain dev SIGINT → 0; `--fresh` SIGINT → 130; `--fresh` SIGTERM → 143; no config → 1.

### cli.qa-suite-execution → PASS

Boot: `OS_PORT=P pnpm dev -- --fresh -p P`.

- a[0] → pass. Bare `os test --url … --token …` from examples/app-showcase:
  - `Found 1 test suites.`
  - `✅ … [health-liveness] (42ms)` and `✅ … [category-create-read-roundtrip] (194ms)`
  - `SUCCESS: All 2 scenarios passed.`, EXIT=0, and green again on a second run.
  - The category list was the same 4 rows before and after both runs.
- a[1] → pass.
  - A no-teardown copy passed reading back via `{{categoryId}}`.
  - An independent GET found exactly one created row.
  - A GET of the literal `{{categoryId}}` → 404.
- a[2] → pass. `Assertion failed: data.status expected degraded, got ok` under `Step Failed: GET health expecting degraded`, EXIT=1.
- a[3] → pass. `… data.nope cannot be evaluated by 'contains' — expected an array or a string at that path, got undefined … Use 'is_null' …`
- a[4] → pass.
  - `qa/a-malformed.test.json is not a valid Quality Protocol suite (TestSuiteSchema):` / `✗ scenarios.0.steps: Invalid input: expected array, received undefined`.
  - No Scenario line followed it; the sibling suites still ran. EXIT=1.
- a[5] → pass. The scenario failed (❌), and the created row was gone after teardown.
- a[6] → pass.
  - ✅ api_call, wait, create_record, read_record, update_record, delete_record, query_records.
  - ❌ `Unsupported action type in HttpAdapter: run_script`.
- a[7] → pass. Bare `os test` took 4.9 s; `'qa/**/*.test.json'` took 4.4 s, with the same suite in sorted order.
- negative[0]–[4] → pass.
  - Zero match: `Found 0 test suites.` … `Exiting 0 — an empty match is not a failure.`, EXIT=0; with `--fail-on-empty`, EXIT=1.
  - With no token, health passes (✅) and the roundtrip fails (❌) with HTTP 401.

  - `objects[13].externalSharingModel: externalSharingModel → (removed) (object-external-sharing-model-removed)`

- a[2] → pass.
  - The snapshot is migrated, and `✓ Migrated stack is schema-valid` agrees with `schemaValid: true`.
  - A `pollInterval` probe → `⚠ Migrated stack does not yet pass schema validation …` with `schemaValid: false`.
- a[3] → pass.
  - The written tree run `--from 17` has no Applied block, EXIT=0.
  - Identical runs diff empty.
  - `--from 18` → `⚠ No migration step exists for protocol 18 → 18 … not a finding that the metadata is canonical.`
- a[4] → pass. `--from 15` → `✗ Cannot migrate from protocol 15: the chain's support floor is 16 (ADR-0087 D3)`, exit 1; with `--json` → `unsupported_from_major`, exit 1.
- a[5] → pass. 406 `⚠ [protocol N]` advisories, separate from the Applied lines.
- a[6] → pass. `--json` exit 0, and `--write --json` exit 0.
- a[7] → pass.
  - `Wrote 5 of 5 mechanical change(s) into 3 file(s):` then `✓ Re-ran the chain over the written sources: no mechanical change remains.`
  - `diff -r` shows only the 5 listed hunks.
  - A spread plant → `not written [spread]`.
- negative[0]–[6] → pass.

- a[0] → pass. The unconditional rows print; there is no `@objectstack/spec` row in the scaffold; the NODE_ENV row prints only while NODE_ENV is unset.

- a[2] → pass. `✗ Tenancy posture OS_TENANCY_POSTURE="isolatd" is not a recognized tenancy posture …`; the later sections still print; exit 1, with no "Could not load config".

- a[7] → pass.
  - `ℹ Test coverage Skipped — no packages/spec/src in this directory (monorepo-only check)` and the same for Deprecations.

### cli.migrate-duplicates-inventory → PASS

The fixture is a minimal scratch stack (`qadup_ticket` and `qadup_note`), seeded with SQL after one `os dev` boot (see accuracy finding C2).

- a[0] → pass. Every contract key is present (report `duplicate-identifiers`, `reportVersion` 2, `globalPartition` `__global__`, the counters, three preflight entries, the summary keys). The contract pin passed.
- a[1] → pass. The cross-partition `0001` is reported with partitions `[__global__, org_…]`; the within-partition `DUPX` appears nowhere.
- a[2] → pass. The sha256 of the row, sequence and sqlite_master dumps is identical before and after every run.
- a[3] → pass. `idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active` is blocked (`qa_b_dup_view`, rowCount 2), the other two are clear, and `os migrate plan` does not see it.
- a[4] → pass.
  - `liveConditions` reports `globalLastValue: 1` and an org counter at 4.
  - With the org counter deleted the list is empty.
  - With the sequences table dropped, counters.status is `absent` and the duplicates are still reported.
- a[5] → pass. `.filter` is null, then `{object:qadup_ticket}`, then `{object:qadup_note}`.
- a[6] → pass.
  - `OS_DATABASE_URL` and `--database-url` give the same database and equal duplicates.
  - With a dropped table, `.skipped` names it with a reason.
- a[7] → pass.
  - The null-seam, contract and pre-repair pins: 3 files, 18 tests passed.
  - `--database-url memory://qa` → `{"error":"boot_failed",…}`, EXIT=1.
- negative[0]–[3] → pass.
  - `--json` → `Nonexistent flag: --json`, exit 2 (the declared contract).
  - stdout is one JSON document, and the boot logs go to stderr.

## Change against round 2 (ba4afcc2)

- `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18` and `cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts`: PASS in #24598, PARTIAL here.
  - Their non-test clauses have a CLI or REST oracle, and the pins are spec and lint units that drive neither. #24598 scored them as covered.
  - This is a reading of coverage, not a product change: every pin still passes.
- `cli.dev-boot-contract`: PASS in round 1 (#24551; round 2 did not rerun it), PARTIAL here. The cause is a[0]'s console leg on a tree without a console build, which this round chose not to build.

## Closed-card verification (fixes from earlier rounds, re-measured at 580fd4ed)

- #24563, list view outside the writing package's closure: **the fix holds.** Measured on a `single` showcase boot (scratch copy, `os dev --seed-admin`, own DB).
  - `POST /api/v1/packages` creates `com.qa.vfy3` (no dependencies).
  - `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qavfy_r1?package=com.qa.vfy3` with columns `title` and `zzz_nope` → 422 INVALID_METADATA `list-view-object-outside-closure` at `views[0].data.object`.
  - The draft save is 200, then `POST /packages/com.qa.vfy3/publish-drafts` → `outcome: "refused"`, failedCount 1, with the same rule.
  - Binding `nosuch_obj` → the same 422.
  - Controls: the overlay (no `?package`) → 422 `list-view-field-unknown` at `views[0].columns[1].field`. A package declaring `dependencies: {"com.example.showcase": "*"}` → the same 422 `list-view-field-unknown`, and a known field → 200. The GET of the refused view → 404.
- #24567, three CLI-sweep findings: **all three rows hold.**
  - Row 1: `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` is at r4, and acceptance[2] reads "the refused boot wrote no row and ran no D10 step …".
  - Row 2: `access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report` is at r2, and acceptance[1] reads "… 422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED whose message names each conflicting name and its holder".
  - Row 3, measured live on a v17-shaped SQLite: a v18 DB from `os migrate apply --yes --json`, then `ALTER TABLE sys_platform_setting ADD COLUMN organization_id TEXT`.
    - `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes` → exit 1, `✗ Refusing this --allow-destructive run: it would drop organization_id from sys_platform_setting, a drop the organization-ownership ceremony owns … 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, whose ceremony drops these columns itself … Nothing in this run was applied.`
    - `--json` → `message: refused_organization_ownership_unmigrated`, `tables: ["sys_platform_setting"]`.
    - The output no longer names `os migrate organization-ownership --out` or `--plan-file`. `os migrate organization-ownership --help` EXAMPLES now show the 18.0 refusal.

## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps (for the anchor #24579, not extracted)

- C1 `cli.migrate-duplicates-inventory` acceptance[3] verify: plan's `[Registry] Registered view: …` lines are on stderr at 580fd4ed, not stdout; stdout is pure JSON. The conclusion still holds.
- C2 `cli.migrate-duplicates-inventory` fixture: stock showcase declares one org-scoped identifier (`showcase_field_zoo.f_autonumber`). The within-partition repeat needs a second one, and seeding it needs the partitioned unique index (`uniq_OBJ_organization_id_FIELD`) dropped first, after which `os migrate plan` reports the drop as `index_mismatch`. requires[1] should say both.
- C3 `cli.dev-boot-contract` acceptance[0]: the console leg needs `pnpm objectui:build`. State it in requires or knownGaps; on an unbuilt tree `/_console/` answers 503 "Console is not built".
- C4 `cli.dev-boot-contract`, config-default-datasource variant: the scratch stack's object must declare `sharingModel`, or compile fails on `security-owd-unset` and the boot exits 1.
- C5 `cli.migrate-meta-codemod` steps[6]: the warning now reads `⚠ Migrated stack does not yet pass schema validation — 1 refusal left after the chain. Resolve them, then run \`os validate\`:`.
